publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency Air Quality System AirData
source_visibility: historical bulk data retrospectively published; NOT contemporaneous live availability; no observed action/policy
monitor_split: integer SHA256 of exact zero-padded canonical owner ID first 16 hex digits modulo 100; train 0..69, dev 70..84, sealed_test 85..99
source_event_identity: one owner-qualified observed GMT clock hour, NOT row order; unobserved hours never fabricated
duplicate_policy: if owner+GMT clock appears more than once in assigned phase, exclude that event from eligible count; count collisions and freeze their number without consulting numerical readings
source_quality_policy: record all observed method, qualifier and units metadata only, freeze acceptable unit and qualifier list before training; default reject qualified nonblank or uncertain units/method; do not score any target while this is unresolved
source_month_selection: fixed calendar phases regardless of numeric PM2.5 and prior model results
metadata_only_eligibility: site/POC/source-clock counts, not target concentration/variance/retention score
training_features: one actual observed PM2.5 measurement plus source-known event clock; other 13 Beijing physical channels NOT fabricated and not silently zeroed into pretrained model
source_adaptation_gate: implement source-specific common input and retrain ~100k models / same source train/holdout; no raw Beijing checkpoint cross-source score promotion
required_learned_parameters: 95000..105000 per model, <=1% between trained architectures, all live weights
training_compare_budget: equal actual source observations/target splits/optimizer budgets, complete forward/backward/optimizer mathematical FLOPs; CPU time need NOT match
preserve_checkpoint: all original model weights, optimizer state, RNG source order/state, real source SHA, site IDs, replay inputs and independent fixed real holdout audit
seal_policy: no numeric Sample Measurement field read during intake, nor in DEV/TEST until appropriate preregistered future stage and original model freeze
intake_receipt: research/source-bundles/PAR-MEM-014/EPA2024-METADATA-RECEIPT.json committed ONCE, subsequent runs source SHA and receipt exact replay
